item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossy)】PACK - Madonna - The Complete Instrumental Albums (1983 - 2008) Directory
item.description:
Madonna The Complete Instrumental Albums (1983 - 2008)

To make things easier for everyone, I've created a directory containing Madonna instrumentals. Feel free to browse, download, and enjoy the collection.

Source:

Some of the instrumentals were extracted directly from Madonna's official maxi-singles and EPs, then organized into a single collection.

For tracks that were not officially released as instrumentals, I sourced them from various websites to make the collection as complete as possible. I also converted the audio files from MP3 320 kbps to M4A 256 kbps (AAC) for better compatibility with Apple devices and apps.
